notes.title: Update : Fly like a bird...plus lots of visual enhancements
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27518775/5ef7f4ca32f4d5460adcab436e0faed78aea5ed0.jpg

Ok guys added the first mini-game to our VR App

Climb the Observation deck at the Solar Farm and throw paper planes off the top....using subtle hand control, you will be able to guide the planes...

Feeling daring then why not jump onto the plane for a ride...(not for the faint hearted)

Once you have mastered the controls, why not take a screen shot and post it in the forum...we hope to add scoreboard eventually...

Have fun...happy flying...

also....we have updated lots more with detail that visually enhance many parts of the whole VR experience...


360 Evolve

notes.title: V1.05 :Update - Bugs, Improvements and Extras ! (released 11 Mar 2017)
notes.content:
This release sees :-

Update to Unreal 4.15 Engine...giving improved visuals..
Fixed lots of small detail issues and bugs.
TableTronics - Now becomes Virtual Lab

 Virtual Lab  is an interesting way of learning about electronics..
with small components that can be placed on a circuit board 
and interacted with.

Virtual Lab has 2 circuit board to interact with... lots more coming...

Will record a video for demonstration soon...

Continued creation of the Gaming Element...still not available yet..

notes.title: Latest Update - Bugs and Improvements (released 07 Feb 2017) v1.04
notes.content:
This releases sees 

Bugs was stopping the house starting power without GRID ON, now the house can be totally off Grid. (assuming there is power in the Battery or Solar power being generated)

Standby power now operates...draining a small amount of power on the house when power is enabled (GRID / BATTERY / SOLAR) 
Just look at your watch when power is enabled..

The Game component is being moved into the main SANDBOX, this means that there is only one option now on the MAIN MENU, "START" , the game will be enabled by a control on a wall in the kitchen... (still not available to play yet..)

Hoping this fix has sorted nearly all issues around how power moves around the house...try enabling battery and then a bit of solar for 30 seconds.. then switch SOLAR off and see how long the house keeps running by just using the battery

Remember all the data used in the Simulation is close to real-world data

Enjoy !
